bio: Philosopher and moral psychologist. Research Fellow, London School of Economics. Co-author of 'Effective Altruism and the Human Mind: The Clash Between Impact and Intuition' (Oxford University Press, 2025, with Lucius Caviola). PhD in Philosophy, Lund University; MPhil Psychology, University of Cambridge; MSc Neuroscience, University College London. Previously: University of Oxford, Centre for Effective Altruism. Based in Stockholm, Sweden.
